VST 2.4 plug-in hosting for PluginUI.Host: scanning (shell plug-ins included), 32-bit float processing, MIDI in and out, parameters, programs, .fxp / .fxb presets, editors. Written from the public description of the VST 2.4 interface; no part of the Steinberg SDK is used. NativeAOT compatible.
Windows audio and MIDI devices for PluginUI.Host: ASIO, WASAPI output and input (shared mode, low latency through IAudioClient3), MIDI input and output (winmm). NativeAOT compatible.

Audio plug-in host for .NET: loads VST3 plug-ins (files, or an NPlug factory in-process; VST 2 with PluginUI.Host.Vst2), scans and catalogs the installed plug-ins, renders audio offline (WAV), measures responses. No UI dependency; NativeAOT compatible.
Desktop applications with PluginUI: application object, JSON settings, recent files, undo stack, document session, message dialogs. NativeAOT or IL.
Embeddable runtime for Haytham modules: module lifecycle, events, managed tasks and resource cleanup. Includes the source generator that builds module manifests at compile time.
ActualLab.Rpc.TypeScript - generates TypeScript contracts (interfaces, DTOs, service definitions) from ActualLab.Rpc services.
ActualLab.Rpc.TypeScript.Generator - an MSBuild target generating TypeScript contracts for ActualLab.Rpc and Fusion services on build.
Shared delivery engine for the AuditLoggingPipeline plugins: bounded channel, retrying sequential sink dispatcher with shutdown drain, HTTP context provider and proxy matching options.
